title: Cart quantity can be increased to the maximum of 10
preconditions: Store is running at http://localhost:3000 and the cart is empty. Use the 'case' SKU for this test.
steps: Navigate to / and click catalog-case-add-button to add the 'case' product to the cart.
Click cart-case-increase-button nine times to raise the quantity to 10.
expected: The element cart-case-qty shows the exact text '10'.

title: Cart quantity cannot exceed 10 when increase button is clicked
preconditions: Store is running at http://localhost:3000 and the cart is empty.
steps: Navigate to / and click catalog-case-add-button to add the 'case' product.
Click cart-case-increase-button nine times to reach quantity 10 (verify cart-case-qty reads '10').
Click cart-case-increase-button one more time, attempting to reach 11.
expected: The element cart-case-qty still shows the exact text '10'; the quantity does not increase to 11.

title: Shipping is $7.99 when post-discount subtotal is exactly $99.99 (just below free-shipping threshold)
preconditions: Cart is empty. Add products (reading each unit price from the catalog via data-testid catalog-<sku>-price) until the cart subtotal is exactly 9999 cents ($99.99) with no coupon applied.
steps: Navigate to / and read unit prices from catalog-<sku>-price elements for available SKUs.
Add products and adjust quantities until cart-subtotal shows exactly '$99.99' (no coupon applied).
Read cart-tax: 6% of 9999 cents = 599.94 cents, rounded half up = 600 cents = $6.00.
expected: cart-shipping shows '$7.99', cart-tax shows '$6.00', and cart-total shows '$113.98'.

title: Shipping is free when post-discount subtotal is exactly $100.00 (at free-shipping threshold)
preconditions: Cart is empty. Add products until the cart subtotal is exactly 10000 cents ($100.00) with no coupon applied.
steps: Navigate to / and read unit prices from catalog-<sku>-price elements for available SKUs.
Add products and adjust quantities until cart-subtotal shows exactly '$100.00' (no coupon applied).
expected: cart-shipping shows '$0.00', cart-tax shows '$6.00', and cart-total shows '$106.00'.

title: Coupon 'agent10' (lowercase) applies a 10% discount, confirming case-insensitivity
preconditions: Cart has products with a subtotal of exactly $100.00 (10000 cents) and no coupon applied yet.
steps: Post-discount subtotal = 10000 - 1000 = 9000 cents = $90.00, below $100.00 so shipping = 799 cents = $7.99.
expected: cart-coupon-message shows a success confirmation, cart-discount shows '$10.00', cart-shipping shows '$7.99', cart-tax shows '$5.40', and cart-total shows '$103.39'.

title: Invalid coupon code is rejected and no discount is applied
preconditions: Cart has at least one product and no coupon currently applied.
steps: Read cart-discount to confirm no discount was applied.
expected: cart-coupon-message shows an error indicating the coupon is invalid, and cart-discount shows '$0.00'.

title: Tax is 6% of post-discount subtotal with half-up rounding at a fractional-cent boundary
preconditions: Cart has products with a subtotal of exactly $4.25 (425 cents) and no coupon applied.
steps: Navigate to / and add products until cart-subtotal reads exactly '$4.25'.
Read cart-tax: 6% of 425 cents = 25.50 cents, rounded half up = 26 cents = $0.26.
expected: cart-tax shows '$0.26' (demonstrating half-up rounding of 25.50 cents to 26 cents).

title: Declined card shows 'Your card was declined.' on checkout
preconditions: Cart is empty. A fresh e2e- email is available, e.g. e2e-decline-20261013@example.com.
steps: Navigate to / and click catalog-case-add-button to add a product.
Click header-cart-link, then click cart-checkout-button to go to /checkout.
expected: checkout-error-alert shows the exact text 'Your card was declined.'

title: Cart contents survive a declined payment
preconditions: Cart is empty. A fresh e2e- email is available, e.g. e2e-persist-20261013@example.com.
steps: Navigate to / and click catalog-case-add-button, then catalog-charger-add-button to add two products.
Click header-cart-link and verify cart-case-line and cart-charger-line are visible.
Type a name into checkout-name-input and 'e2e-persist-20261013@example.com' into checkout-email-input.
Wait for checkout-error-alert to show the decline message.
expected: Both cart-case-line and cart-charger-line are still visible, and cart-case-qty and cart-charger-qty each still show their original quantities (1).

title: Confirmation page shows 'Processing payment...' when order is still PENDING after checkout
preconditions: Cart is empty. A fresh e2e- email is available, e.g. e2e-pending-20261013@example.com. NOTE: Defect ZTM-5 means Stripe webhooks may not arrive automatically, so the order may stay PENDING; this test verifies the PENDING confirmation-page state.
steps: Navigate to / and click catalog-case-add-button to add a product.
Click header-cart-link, then click cart-checkout-button to go to /checkout.
Read checkout-total and note the exact dollar amount shown.
Type a name into checkout-name-input and 'e2e-pending-20261013@example.com' into checkout-email-input.
On the order confirmation page, read order-number (the new order id), order-status, and order-total.
expected: order-status shows 'Processing payment...' (PENDING state per ORD-5), and order-total matches the checkout-total amount read in step 3.
